MktCalcInsightObjectDef.expression: SELECT APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(ssot__DeviceApplicationEngagement__dlm.ssot__DeviceId__c) AS device_count__c, ssot__DeviceApplicationEngagement__dlm.ssot__SoftwareApplicationId__c AS app_id__c FROM ssot__DeviceApplicationEngagement__dlm WHERE ( (ssot__DeviceApplicationEngagement__dlm.ssot__EngagementDateTm__c >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)) AND ssot__DeviceApplicationEngagement__dlm.ssot__EngagementChannelActionId__c = 'APP_OPEN' ) GROUP BY app_id__c
